sections.name: summary
sections.value: Solo PM delivery for plan 132: RED witnesses, additive spawn bind reporting, parent preservation, deterministic and live proof, review.

value.title: Establish RED-first spawn and dead-pane witnesses
value.success: Child-exit, parent-loss, and unbound dead-pane retry behavior fail before implementation.

value.title: Implement additive bind and bounded dead-pane reporting
value.success: Spawn reports bind or named failure; an unbound seat whose pane disappeared leaves named terminal queue state; parent is preserved.

value.title: Prove and review composed behavior
value.success: Deterministic checks, live proof, and cross-model review are complete.

tk-a132.assertion: The child-exit, parent-preservation, and unbound dead-pane terminal-state witnesses fail on the pre-fix tree for the expected behavior.

tk-b132.assertion: Spawn separates dispatched from bound, returns early-exit evidence, emits spawn.bound/spawn.failed, preserves parent, and terminalizes an unbound missing-pane queue row with a named failed outcome.

tk-c132.assertion: Focused Rust tests, harness checks, and healthy plus failing live tmux transcripts prove all acceptance criteria.
